China Removes Two Top Generals from Military Command

China has formally removed two senior generals, Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli, from their positions as members of the Central Military Commission, the country's supreme military command body. The removals were reported by state media, indicating the generals have been under investigation for alleged discipline violations since January. Their specific roles and the exact nature of the alleged violations were not detailed in the coverage.
